about: One entry per TTS call, in speaking order. Spell numbers out. A delivery tag only where a line needs one (Gus: [deadpan]); the narrator reads untagged. facts = tags from FACTS.md (D = dramatised, adds no fact). Fill take after recording (tools/tts.py): tempo 1.0, never time-stretched or pitch-shifted; pause = the heard pause before the line. About 80-90 words in all for 36-42 s; cut words, not speed.
